body: This is the modpack I made and use in all of my Minecraft videos. It changes the core feel of the game by adding new combat, new animations, improved sounds, better visuals, and quality‑of‑life features. The pack includes mods like Better Combat, Fresh Animations, Enhanced Visuals, Ambient Sounds, Xaero’s Minimap and World Map, Sodium, and more. It’s designed to make Minecraft feel more alive, more dynamic, and more fun to play.
